items.headline: Co-defendant of Arnold sentenced to 10 years in Florida case
items.description: A co-defendant of Terrion Arnold was sentenced to 10 years in Florida after pleading guilty to his role in the robbery and kidnapping case that also involves the Seattle Seahawks cornerback, the Hillsborough County State Attorney's Office said Monday.
